ryan-yang125-motion-lexicon-motionboard.description: Make product launch films and single shots in the style of Apple and Linear launch films, from 38 recipes (HyperFrames, HTML + GSAP rendered to MP4). Use when the user asks for a product launch film, promo video, product reveal, feature video or app trailer; wants to recreate a specific shot from a launch film; asks for Apple-style or Linear-style motion, either as a video or as a hero animation on a website; or names a shot from the recipe index (Match Cut, Tilted UI with Depth of Field, Auto Zoom, Morph Relay, Light Reveal and the rest). Also applies to requests in Chinese such as 做宣传片,…
